Thiago Agustin Tirante: Thiago Agustin Tirante enters strong form after defeating Alejandro Tabilo to reach his first career ATP final at the BNP Paribas Nordic Open in Stockholm. Ahead of his championship match against Taylor Fritz, the in-form Argentine has also been making headlines off the court by opening up candidly about his mental health struggles over the past couple of years.
Taylor Fritz: Taylor Fritz enters in strong form, having recently reached his fourth consecutive quarter-final and advanced to the semi-finals in Stockholm following a walkover from Holger Rune. Prior to this, he suffered a tight loss to Carlos Alcaraz in a Paris thriller after holding a match point, and ultimately missed out on qualifying for the ATP Finals.
